_about: T679 #13: the hand fixes the added-streams generator applies to the city layers before it resolves them — a feature dropped by name, a misspelt name mapped onto its creek, a single bad piece dropped by its src_id, and a piece forced to drain into a named creek. Moved out of the generator's code (clean.py, build_dataset.py) unchanged; each group keeps the reason it was written with. Hand-written (Claude / the owner, from a look at the layer and the map). Read ONLY by the generator (`pipeline.atlas.waters.added_streams.clean.calls`), which writes the reviewed `added_streams.json` — never by the atlas build, so a change here reaches the map only through a regenerated and reviewed added_streams.json.

exclude_names.why: a Burnaby creek that does not belong in the Port Moody layer (bad/duplicated data that should never be minted; matched case-insensitively)

name_aliases.why: OID 627 typo — same slough as 626 (StreamDetail agrees); a misspelling splits one creek into two names, so its pieces never merge into one channel

exclude_src_ids.why: Ancient Grove Trib.1 stub; Rudolph 356.1 part; Fraser River; 305 Lost<->Holmes connector; 268/274 Thomas Trib.5; 4/8/9 Squatters Trib.2/1/3; 410 Jerry Rogers Creek; 41.0/41.1 JR Trib.1; 223 Jr 1-3; 105/384/292/405 unnamed spurious pieces
Harris Slough & tribs (654.0, 612, 622.0/.1, 648.0/.1, 659), Whitaker Slough (373, 684), Mamquam Side Channel (609), Dryden Creek Trib 1 (666), Stawamus River + Trib 1 (589, 590)

Little Stawamus: 651.5 is a spur off the 651.3/651.4 junction; 651.2 is an exact duplicate of 651.1 whose parallel edge split the mainstem and disconnected 651.1 from 636 — dropping it reconnects the 651.0-651.1-651.3-651.4-636 run
unnamed spurious pieces (528.2 KEPT: it is the connector that grounds the whole Logger's Lane cluster to its outlet — removing it strands ~16 streams)
Suter Brook Creek spurious pieces (164 = redundant parallel mouth beside 163)
204.1 = Kyle Creek part; 334 = Village Creek piece; 63/329 spurious

receiver_override.why: Magnolia Creek Trib 1 (594) touches Magnolia Creek but the DEM's noding buffer bridged its mouth to Little Stawamus 24 m below the confluence; a general "join the stream you touch" rule wrecked port_moody, so this one is a targeted override instead
